764f7506feadf270.description: Director, West Arabia Division Lead – Security Solutions at Mastercard (KSA) Mastercard (KSA) is seeking a Director, West Arabia Division Lead – Security Solutions. 76c9284eabe1ba90.description: About the Role KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology) is seeking a Research User Computing Lead to provide hands-on technical leadership for its Linux scientific workstation platform. This full-time role, based in Thuwal, Makkah, involves responsibility for the architecture, provisioning, configuration, automation, security, and lifecycle management of these platforms. The Lead will ensure that high-performance Linux workstations and remote workstation services effectively support faculty, researchers, and students across research and teaching activities. Role Context and Leadership While primarily focused on Linux, the Research User Computing Lead will also supervise and provide technical direction to Windows and macOS engineers supporting the wider end-user computing fleet. This includes ensuring alignment, consistency, and reliable service delivery across all platforms. The role requires 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field, contributing to the strategic direction and operational excellence of research computing environments. Key Responsibilities Set the architecture and technical direction for KAUST’s Linux scientific workstation fleet, including configuration management, provisioning, inventory, patching, access control, security, and lifecycle management. Establish infrastructure-as-code, GitOps, automation, and engineering standards for the Linux platform team, and provide technical direction for Windows and macOS endpoint platforms. Lead and document build-vs-buy and tooling decisions for provisioning, configuration management, secrets management, observability, and fleet operations. Own the design and continuous improvement of physical and remote scientific workstation platforms, ensuring secure, high-performance access for users. Oversee platform operations, including bare-metal and virtual provisioning, patch orchestration, inventory, drift detection, observability, reliability, and service continuity. Own the security and compliance posture of the workstation fleet, including host hardening, secrets management, audit logging, and alignment with frameworks such as NIST 800-171 and CIS Benchmarks. Define hardware standards, refresh cycles, model validation, driver compatibility, firmware and BIOS automation, and lifecycle plans. Lead, mentor, supervise, and develop the workstation platform team, including Windows and macOS engineers. Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex platform, provisioning, access-control, hardware, and cross-platform endpoint issues. Work directly with faculty, researchers, students, vendors, and internal IT teams to translate research and teaching needs into sustainable platform capabilities. Partner with network, security, IAM, storage, and advanced computing teams to deliver integrated, secure, and compliant platform services. Provide regular updates and recommendations to senior IT leadership on platform direction, risks, lifecycle planning, investment needs, and service improvements. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in managing and leading technical teams focused on end-user computing platforms, with a strong emphasis on Linux environments. Experience with infrastructure-as-code, automation, and security best practices for workstation fleets is essential. Collaboration and Communication The role requires strong collaboration skills to work effectively with various stakeholders, including faculty, researchers, students, vendors, and internal IT teams. Excellent communication skills are necessary to articulate technical concepts, manage expectations, and provide updates to senior leadership. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Thuwal, Makkah, within the King Abdullah University of Science and Technology. The role operates within a dynamic research and academic environment, supporting cutting-edge scientific endeavors.

7685d08aa01fa40f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نباتات للمقاولات عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجفر، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان التشغيل الفعال والآمن للشاحنة الصغيرة وفقًا للمسارات والخطط المحددة، مع الالتزام التام بمعايير السلامة المرورية والتشغيلية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنة الصغيرة ضمن المسارات المحددة وخطط العمل المعتمدة. الالتزام الصارم بجميع قواعد المرور، وإجراءات الأمن والسلامة، وتجنب ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية. إجراء الفحوصات الدورية على الشاحنة للتحقق من سلامتها وكفاءتها. معالجة المشكلات والأعطال البسيطة التي قد تطرأ على الشاحنة بشكل فوري. رفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة للخبراء المختصين عند ملاحظة أي أعطال تتطلب تدخلًا متخصصًا. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية، وأدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة المتبعة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في قيادة الشاحنات الصغيرة أو ما يعادلها. رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول تتناسب مع نوع المركبة المطلوبة. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات الأساسية للمركبة وتحديد المشكلات البسيطة. المهارات المطلوبة الالتزام والانضباط في العمل. القدرة على اتباع التعليمات والخطط الموضوعة بدقة. الوعي العالي بقواعد المرور والسلامة على الطرق. مهارات حل المشكلات الأساسية المتعلقة بالمركبات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الجفر بالمنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب العمل ضمن فريق ملتزم بمعايير السلامة والجودة في جميع المهام الموكلة إليه. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

76909c3579cdaaf6.company_name: شركة الخدمات الاستشارية السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية
76909c3579cdaaf6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الخدمات الاستشارية السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية عن رسام هندسي مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد المخططات التنفيذية والتصميمية لمشاريع البنية التحتية، بما في ذلك الطرق وشبكات المياه والصرف الصحي وتصريف الأمطار. سيعمل الرسام الهندسي بالتنسيق المباشر مع المهندسين المدنيين لضمان دقة المخططات ومطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد المخططات التنفيذية والتصميمية لمشاريع البنية التحتية باستخدام برامج AutoCAD وCivil 3D. رسم المساقط والقطاعات الطولية والعرضية للطرق وشبكات المياه والصرف الصحي وتصريف الأمطار. إعداد مخططات التنسيق بين الخدمات المختلفة وتحديد أي تعارضات محتملة. تحويل المسوحات الميدانية والرسومات الأولية إلى مخططات رقمية دقيقة ومفصلة. إعداد مخططات ما بعد التنفيذ (As-Built) التي تعكس الوضع الفعلي للمشروع بعد الانتهاء. تعديل المخططات بناءً على ملاحظات المهندسين والاستشاريين والعملاء. استخراج الكميات الأولية للمواد والمكونات عند الحاجة. الالتزام بالمعايير والمتطلبات الفنية للجهات الحكومية ذات الصلة. تنظيم وأرشفة الملفات والمستندات الهندسية وفقًا لنظام إدارة الوثائق المعتمد. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات كرسام هندسي مدني. إتقان استخدام برامج الرسم الهندسي مثل AutoCAD وCivil 3D. فهم جيد لمشاريع البنية التحتية، بما في ذلك الطرق وشبكات المياه والصرف الصحي وتصريف الأمطار. القدرة على تحويل التصاميم والمسوحات الميدانية إلى مخططات دقيقة. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق والتنسيق مع المهندسين. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل الرسام الهندسي ضمن فريق متخصص، ويدعم مشاريع الشركة في مجال الاستشارات الهندسية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

76a72302fa2db6c2.job_title: Store Manager Prada Beauty Westfield Mall

76f30a3b3176dfee.description: Regional Sales Manager at AJEX AJEX is seeking a Regional Sales Manager to lead the regional sales team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical for driving revenue, securing new business, and ensuring customer retention across all AJEX Logistics units within an assigned region (Central, Western, Eastern, or UAE). The position combines leadership responsibilities with direct key account management and reports to the Sales Director as a key member of the Sales Leadership Team. Role Overview The Regional Sales Manager is fully accountable for the regional sales performance, including revenue targets and pipeline quality. This role involves building and developing a high-performing sales team, enforcing AJEX sales standards, and ensuring daily CRM discipline. The manager is responsible for translating regional strategy into measurable weekly results and ensuring that all sales personnel meet or exceed their targets. Key Responsibilities Achieve regional monthly revenue targets across Network, FTL/PTL, Fulfillment, Airfreight, Life Science, and Project business units. Lead, coach, and develop the regional sales team through weekly one-on-one meetings. Recruit sales talent with a proven track record of portable revenue and develop a succession plan for key positions. Ensure daily CRM updates by all team members, verifying completeness and accuracy of pipeline, forecast, and activity data. Conduct weekly regional KPI reviews covering pipeline, forecast vs. target, down traders, lost customers, new contracts, and open contracts without revenue. Prepare and present monthly Sales Region Reviews to the Sales Director and Chief Logistics Officer, including corrective actions. Manage underperforming team members (below 80% of target or minimum revenue standard) with structured improvement plans and clear consequences. Directly manage the region's top key accounts and lead strategic tenders and RFQs. Ensure each salesperson acquires a minimum of 5 new customers per month, with new contracts generating first revenue within 7 days. Drive customer retention by identifying down traders early, implementing recovery plans, and preventing customer losses in collaboration with Operations and Customer Service. Align with Operations on capacity, onboarding, and service quality, ensuring 5 joint customer visits per salesperson per month. Maintain pricing discipline and margin quality, approving quotations within the delegated authority matrix. Collaborate with Finance and the Collection Team to keep regional DSO and overdue receivables within target. Apply the AJEX escalation rule: escalate to the next position if no response is received within 24 hours. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in sales, with a significant portion in a leadership role. Demonstrated ability to manage and develop high-performing sales teams. Proven track record of achieving revenue targets and driving business growth. Strong understanding of logistics operations and sales processes. Proficiency in CRM systems and data analysis for sales forecasting and pipeline management. Key Performance Indicators Regional monthly revenue versus target, broken down by business unit. Percentage of team members achieving or exceeding 100% of their target. Number of new customers won per month (team and individual salesperson). Forecast accuracy and weighted pipeline coverage against target. Regional down trader and lost customer rates. Time to first revenue for new contracts (maximum 7 days). Team CRM compliance (daily updates, data completeness). Regional gross margin and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO). Retention of top performers and time to fill open sales positions. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring a commitment to leading a dynamic sales team within the logistics sector.

76572e733696e2d5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص، ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة تنفيذها لضمان أفضل النتائج للمرضى. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ السيرة المرضية المفصلة من المريض وذويه، وإجراء دراسة شاملة للحالة المرضية. إجراء الفحص السريري الدقيق وطلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى الصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية حسب الحاجة. قراءة وتفسير نتائج الفحوصات والتقارير لتشخيص الحالة المرضية بدقة ضمن مجال التخصص. وضع خطة علاجية متكاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها بفعالية. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية للمريض ومدى فاعلية الخطة العلاجية المطبقة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمرضى وحفظها بشكل منظم ودقيق. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التخصص الطبي. القدرة على دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في وضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعتها. القدرة على تقييم تطور الحالات المرضية وفاعلية العلاج. بيئة العمل يعمل الطبيب الاخصائي ضمن فريق صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان في الرياض. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل في بيئة مهنية داعمة تركز على تقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى. معلومات إضافية هذا الدور يمثل فرصة للأطباء المتخصصين للانضمام إلى مؤسسة طبية مرموقة والمساهمة في تقديم خدمات رعاية صحية متميزة. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

7688aa3317d205d5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قوة الرياضة لخدمات الأعمال القابضة عن مدربة رياضية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة بريدة. يتضمن هذا الدور العمل بدوام كامل، وهو مناسب للمرشحات ذوات الخبرة الحديثة أو المحدودة في مجال التدريب الرياضي. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم برامج تدريب رياضي فعالة ومناسبة لمختلف المستويات. متابعة تقدم المتدربات وتقديم الدعم والإرشاد اللازم. ضمان بيئة تدريب آمنة ومحفزة. الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية والأخلاقية في مجال التدريب الرياضي. المؤهلات والمتطلبات الحصول على دورة مدرب محترف معتمدة من وزارة الرياضة. خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التدريب الرياضي. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. مهارات تواصل جيدة. بيئة العمل ستعمل المدربة الرياضية في مدينة بريدة ضمن فريق شركة قوة الرياضة لخدمات الأعمال القابضة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتوفر بيئة عمل داعمة تهدف إلى تطوير الكفاءات الرياضية. تفاصيل الراتب يتراوح الراتب الشهري لهذا الدور بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي، وذلك بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المرشحات المؤهلات والمهتمات بالانضمام إلى فريقنا في بريدة إلى تقديم طلباتهن.

76f525cd786703cd.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص، ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تقييم تطور الحالات وفاعلية العلاج. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ السيرة المرضية الشاملة من المريض وذويه، ودراسة الحالة المرضية بعناية. إجراء الفحص السريري اللازم وطلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية، بالإضافة إلى الصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية حسب الحاجة. قراءة وتفسير النتائج والتقارير الطبية لتشخيص الحالة المرضية بدقة ضمن موضوع التخصص. وضع خطة علاجية متكاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها لضمان أفضل النتائج للمريض. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية وفاعلية الخطة العلاجية بشكل مستمر. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمريض وحفظها وفقاً للمعايير المهنية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال طب الأسنان كطبيب اخصائي. القدرة على دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وذويهم. بيئة العمل يعمل الطبيب الاخصائي في عيادات صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان بالمدينة المنورة ضمن بيئة مهنية داعمة، ويكون جزءاً من فريق طبي متخصص يلتزم بتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. المدينة: المدينة المنورة. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة المهنية في صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان.

76085099bb949e73.description: The QA/QC Manager will oversee and ensure the quality of housing renovation and refurbishment works performed by contractors and subcontractors. The role is responsible for ensuring compliance with approved drawings, project specifications, contractual requirements, applicable codes, and the Project Quality Plan, from initial site inspections through final handover. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement the Project Quality Plan, procedures, and inspection requirements. Lead and supervise multidisciplinary Civil, Architectural, Electrical, and Mechanical QA/QC teams. Review method statements, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), material submittals, and quality documentation. Monitor renovation activities, including demolition, structural repairs, waterproofing, finishes, MEP works, and reinstatement. Coordinate inspections, material approvals, testing, and commissioning with the client and consultant. Identify quality issues, manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and ensure corrective actions are completed. Conduct site inspections and quality audits to ensure compliance with approved standards. Manage snagging, final inspections, as-built drawings, O&M manuals, and project handover documentation. Monitor contractor and subcontractor performance and prepare periodic quality reports and KPIs. Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Architectural, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering. Minimum 10 years of QA/QC experience in construction and building projects. Minimum 5 years of experience in a management position. Proven experience in housing renovation, residential refurbishment, or building rehabilitation projects. Strong knowledge of ISO 9001, quality management systems, inspections, NCR management, testing and commissioning, and handover processes. Experience managing contractors, subcontractors, consultants, and multidisciplinary quality teams. Strong communication, leadership, reporting, and problem-solving skills. ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification preferred. PMP, RMP, and Six Sigma certifications preferred. Registration with the relevant local engineering authority, where required.

7651b162df32a00f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة دار مكه للاستشارات الهندسية عن مشرف موقع إنشائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على المواقع الإنشائية لضمان تطبيق القواعد واللوائح الخاصة بالإنشاءات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراقبة مدى التزام مواقع الإنشاءات بالقواعد واللوائح المعمول بها. الإبلاغ عن أي مخالفات وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. متابعة تنفيذ الإجراءات التصحيحية في المواقع الإنشائية لضمان الامتثال. مراجعة المخططات الأولية والخطط الخاصة بمشاريع الإنشاءات. إصدار تراخيص للمضي قدماً في الأعمال بعد التأكد من الالتزام بالمتطلبات. فحص النظم المختلفة مثل أجهزة الرفع والنقل والممرات الجانبية المتحركة. التأكد من مطابقة هذه النظم للمواصفات المطلوبة. تطبيق إجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية في جميع مراحل العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في الإشراف على المواقع الإنشائية. فهم عميق للقواعد واللوائح الخاصة بالإنشاءات. القدرة على تحديد المخالفات وتطبيق الإجراءات التصحيحية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في مجال الاستشارات الهندسية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

763d346e8659110e.description: About the Role Refad is seeking a Sales Consultant to join their team in Al Khobar, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on achieving sales targets, generating leads, and managing client relationships within the real estate sector. The consultant will oversee the entire sales journey, from initial inquiry to reservation and property handover, while coordinating with internal teams and external partners. Key Responsibilities Achieve monthly and annual sales targets aligned with company objectives. Generate and convert leads through various channels, including referrals, brokers, networking, exhibitions, and digital platforms. Conduct project presentations and property tours for prospective clients. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, brokers, and potential buyers. Manage the sales cycle from initial inquiry and follow-up to reservation, SPA signing, and handover coordination. Coordinate with the sales team on bookings, cancellations, payments, delivery observations, and property handovers. Liaise with the Marketing Department for promotional campaigns, lead generation, and customer visits to project sites. Regularly monitor the readiness and condition of project show villas. Maintain strong relationships with banks and financing institutions to facilitate customer financing and support sales opportunities. Maintain accurate sales pipelines, customer records, and follow-up activities using CRM systems. Monitor market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities. Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable real estate regulations. Candidate Requirements Saudi citizen. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Real Estate, or a related field. Valid FAL Sales License. Proven experience (2-5 years) in achieving sales targets and closing real estate deals. Good understanding of the Saudi real estate market and property financing processes. Experience coordinating with marketing teams, brokers, and financing institutions. Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Proficiency in CRM systems and Microsoft Office. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

76e101013b4f3474.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رمال السواحل للمقاولات والصيانة عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التجميع والتركيب والتشغيل والصيانة الوقائية للمعدات والتجهيزات الصناعية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 5 و10 سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية لمشاريع الأعمال الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات التوزيع لأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذ هذه الإجراءات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. معرفة قوية بمبادئ التصميم الميكانيكي وأنظمة التدفئة والتبريد والتكييف. القدرة على إعداد المخططات والوثائق الفنية بدقة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة رمال السواحل للمقاولات والصيانة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الميكانيكيين ذوي الخبرة والمهتمين بهذا الدور للتقديم.

76e1696b6f3905d5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اتقان العربية عن كهربائي مباني للانضمام إلى فريقها في العلا، المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تركيب وصيانة وتصليح الأسلاك الكهربائية والأجهزة والتجهيزات في مختلف المباني والمنشآت. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات في المجال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب المعدات الكهربائية في المباني، بما في ذلك الكابلات الكهربائية والأسلاك والأجهزة الأخرى. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الروتينية كجزء من برامج الصيانة الوقائية، وتحديد أي أضرار قد تلحق بالمعدات. تصليح واستبدال المعدات الكهربائية المعطلة مثل الكابلات والأسلاك والأجهزة. استخدام مجموعة متنوعة من الأدوات اليدوية والمعدات الأساسية اللازمة لتنفيذ المهام. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في جميع الأوقات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات ككهربائي مبانٍ أو في دور مشابه. فهم قوي لمبادئ وأنظمة الكهرباء. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والرسومات الكهربائية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات فنية ممتازة في تركيب وصيانة الأنظمة الكهربائية. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل كهربائي المباني ضمن فريق شركة اتقان العربية في مشاريعها بمنطقة العلا، المدينة المنورة. يتطلب الدور العمل بدوام كامل في بيئة تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

Custom Code & Scripting: Write advanced, highly efficient JavaScript, Script Includes, Business Rules, UI Actions, and custom patterns for complex discovery and integration scenarios. Infrastructure Knowledge: Strong foundation in networking, cloud computing (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), operating systems (Linux/Windows), and storage arrays to correctly build discovery patterns. Industry certifications in specific observability platforms or cloud environments (e.g., AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, Datadog/Dynatrace certifications). ITOM/CMDB Expertise: Proven track record of successfully delivering end-to-end ServiceNow ITOM implementations, with deep mastery over Service Mapping, Discovery, Event Management, and the Common Service Data Model (CSDM) framework. Advanced Scripting & APIs: Exceptional proficiency in server-side/client-side JavaScript, JSON, REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth, and custom MID server script includes. Infrastructure Knowledge: Strong foundation in networking, cloud computing (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), operating systems (Linux/Windows), and storage arrays to correctly build discovery patterns. Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving capabilities, clear communication, and the ability to influence technical decisions across cross-functional infrastructure teams. Required Certifications ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist Discovery (CIS-Discovery) ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist Event Management (CIS-EM) or Service Mapping (CIS-SM) Preferred Qualifications ITIL v4 Foundation or Managing Professional certification. Industry certifications in specific observability platforms or cloud environments (e.g., AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, Datadog/Dynatrace certifications).

76e5865bfaffb8a8.job_title: Senior Project Manager – Greenfield Industrial Project
76e5865bfaffb8a8.description: Job description Company Description Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2024, Sika’s around 33,000 employees generated annual sales of CHF 11.76 billion. Job Description About the Role Sika is undertaking a major strategic investment involving the construction of a new manufacturing facility and the consolidation of existing operations in Saudi Arabia. We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Project Manager to lead the full lifecycle of these projects, from concept development and design through construction, commissioning, start-up, and final handover. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise in industrial construction with proven project management capabilities to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with Sika’s global standards and business objectives. Key Responsibilities Project Leadership & Planning Lead the planning, engineering, execution, and delivery of greenfield industrial construction and site consolidation projects. Develop and manage comprehensive project execution plans, schedules, budgets, risk registers, and resource plans. Define project scope, objectives, milestones, and deliverables in alignment with business requirements. Coordinate activities across multidisciplinary teams including engineering, operations, procurement, finance, HSE, and quality functions. Ensure effective project governance and reporting throughout all project phases. Project Execution & Site Management Manage all construction activities to ensure compliance with approved designs, technical specifications, company standards, and regulatory requirements. Monitor project progress against schedule, budget, and quality objectives, implementing corrective actions when necessary. Conduct regular site inspections, progress reviews, and project meetings. Oversee contractor and subcontractor performance, ensuring contractual obligations, quality standards, and timelines are achieved. Manage project changes, claims, risks, and mitigation plans. Project Controls & Coordination Implement robust project controls covering planning, scheduling, cost control, reporting, and risk management. Utilize project management tools such as Primavera P6 and/or Microsoft Project to track performance and project deliverables. Coordinate engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational readiness activities. Ensure seamless communication and coordination between all project stakeholders. Commissioning & Handover Lead plant commissioning, start-up, testing, and operational readiness activities. Ensure all systems are handed over in accordance with project specifications and operational requirements. Coordinate training, documentation, punch-list closure, and final acceptance processes. Support transition from project execution to plant operations. Stakeholder Management Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external project stakeholders. Liaise with consultants, contractors, suppliers, government authorities, and regulatory agencies. Provide regular project status updates, risk assessments, and financial reports to senior management. Ensure alignment between project objectives and broader business strategies. Governance, Compliance & HSE Ensure full compliance with Saudi Arabian regulations, permitting requirements, industry standards, and Sika policies. Promote and maintain a strong Safety, Health, Environment, and Sustainability (HSES) culture throughout the project lifecycle. Ensure adherence to quality management procedures and corporate governance standards. Maintain effective risk management practices and ensure project documentation is properly controlled and maintained. Qualifications Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline . 76343e00daff7701.description: About Lucidya Lucidya is an AI-native Customer Experience Intelligence platform that helps organizations understand customer conversations, uncover actionable insights, and improve customer experiences through advanced AI capabilities. As the platform continues to grow, maintaining reliable, secure, and high-performing data infrastructure is critical to supporting our customers and enabling continuous product innovation. Our database environment spans multiple cloud platforms and hosting environments, supporting business-critical workloads, high-volume data ingestion, and multi-tenant applications. We are looking for a Database Administrator who can help strengthen our database operations, improve resilience, and ensure our data infrastructure remains reliable as we scale. Why this role matters Our database infrastructure is growing in both scale and complexity. With production PostgreSQL and MySQL environments running across AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and our in-Kingdom hosting environment, maintaining database availability, performance, and recoverability is essential to the reliability of our platform. As a Database Administrator, you’ll take ownership of the health and operational reliability of our production databases. You’ll work on challenges that go beyond routine administration, including multi-terabyte database environments, high-availability architecture, disaster recovery, major-version upgrades, and safe database migrations. You’ll also work closely with engineering, cloud, and reliability teams to help developers make better database decisions, prevent production incidents, and improve the way database changes are designed and delivered. If you enjoy solving complex database performance challenges, building resilient data infrastructure, and taking ownership of critical production systems, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact. What You’ll Do Manage and maintain PostgreSQL and MySQL databases across AWS, GCP, and self-managed environments. Monitor database performance, availability, and capacity. Optimize queries, indexing, and database resource utilization. Manage backups, point-in-time recovery, and disaster recovery. Implement database replication, high availability, and failover strategies. Plan database upgrades, migrations, and safe schema changes. Maintain database security, access controls, and auditing. Automate database operations using Bash, Python, or similar tools. Troubleshoot database incidents and perform root-cause analysis. Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, SRE, and Cloud teams to improve database reliability and scalability. What success looks like (First 90–120 Days) First 30 days: You’ve developed a clear understanding of the production database estate across AWS, GCP, and SITE. You understand the existing database architecture, operational workflows, monitoring, and recovery procedures. You’ve built strong working relationships with the database team, Cloud Engineering, SRE, and development teams. You’ve identified the most significant risks and improvement opportunities across availability, performance, backup, and recovery. By day 60: You’re independently handling assigned database administration and troubleshooting activities. You’ve reviewed backup configurations and started validating recovery procedures for critical databases. You’ve identified gaps in database monitoring and alerting, including replication lag, WAL contention, autovacuum, and table bloat. You’re contributing to database performance improvements and operational documentation. By day 90: Critical database restore tests have been completed or are progressing against an agreed recovery-testing plan, with gaps documented and corrective actions defined. Key database failure scenarios are documented through practical runbooks. Database monitoring and alerting improvements have been implemented for prioritized operational risks. You’re actively contributing to database reliability, performance, and incident-prevention initiatives. By day 120: A safer database change-management process is in place, including appropriate reviews, DDL auditing, and rollback planning. A practical PostgreSQL major-upgrade roadmap has been developed, with compatibility and migration risks assessed. The high-availability approach for the SITE database environment has been evaluated and documented. Database size and activity metrics are available to support the per-customer cost-allocation initiative. Who You Are You’re an experienced Database Administrator who understands that managing production databases is about more than keeping services running. You know how to prevent data loss, diagnose complex performance problems, plan high-risk changes, and build systems that remain reliable under pressure. You’re comfortable working with large, business-critical databases and can balance operational stability with the need to improve architecture, automation, and scalability. Technically, you likely: Have 5+ years of hands-on PostgreSQL administration experience in production. Have experience with AWS Aurora, Amazon RDS, MySQL, and self-managed Linux databases. Understand database performance tuning, replication, high availability, and disaster recovery. Have experience managing multi-terabyte databases, upgrades, and migrations. Can automate database operations using Bash or Python. When it comes to database resilience: You have hands-on experience with backups, recovery, replication, and failover. You can troubleshoot database incidents and minimize downtime. You follow safe change-management practices and maintain rollback plans. When it comes to database performance: You can troubleshoot slow queries, indexing, locking, and resource utilization. You understand PostgreSQL internals and multi-tenant database challenges. What sets you apart: You take ownership and remain calm under pressure. You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with engineering teams. You document your work and continuously improve database reliability. Nice to Have (but not required) Experience with multi-tenant database architectures, particularly schema-per-tenant environments with thousands of schemas. Experience managing databases larger than several terabytes with high write volumes and demanding availability requirements. Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL tooling such as Patroni, pgBackRest, or WAL-G. Experience supporting cloud migrations or moving customer workloads to in-Kingdom hosting environments. Familiarity with database observability, capacity planning, and per-customer database usage or cost allocation. Experience working in SaaS, data-platform, fintech, banking, or telecommunications environments. Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools and automated database provisioning. Relevant certifications, such as EDB PostgreSQL or AWS certifications. What the hiring process will look like Mawhub screening Technical screen (45 min) — [DB Lead] Technical deep-dive (60–90 min) with a practical scenario: diagnosing replication lag and WAL contention, planning a zero-downtime major upgrade — [DB Lead + SRE Team Lead] Hiring manager interview — Mahmoud Moharam, Cloud Manager Culture fit interview - HR Director

7680b0aa0fb317b2.description: Madar is a leading Saudi digital logistics platform owned by Elm transforming transportation management across industries. It connects shippers, carriers, and logistics partners through a unified ecosystem that delivers visibility, efficiency, and automation. Madar enables seamless shipment execution, financial integration, and real-time tracking — redefining the future of logistics in the Kingdom and beyond. Role Overview We are seeking a strategic and experienced Senior Business Development Specialist to support the growth and expansion of Madar’s commercial initiatives across the logistics and technology sectors. This role focuses on identifying new and high-value business opportunities, expanding our customer base, and developing strategic partnerships that contribute to long-term revenue goals. The specialist will analyze industry trends, assess market potential, and help shape the company’s business development strategy. Responsibilities include managing and developing relationships with prospective clients, partners, and industry stakeholders, as well as representing Madar in market interactions to ensure our digital logistics solutions align with evolving customer and industry needs. Success in this role requires strong analytical and commercial capabilities, solid communication and negotiation skills, and effective collaboration with internal teams to support the seamless execution of business initiatives and alignment with Madar’s broader strategic objectives. Key Responsibilities Business Growth & Sales Identify, develop, and pursue new business opportunities in the logistics and supply chain technology market across Saudi Arabia and the GCC region. Manage the end-to-end sales cycle including lead generation, proposal development, negotiation, and contract closure. Develop and present compelling business proposals and solution presentations tailored to client needs. Achieve and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets as set by senior management. Client Relationship Management Serve as the primary point of contact for key clients and prospects, ensuring high levels of engagement and satisfaction. Conduct regular client meetings, needs assessments, and solution demonstrations. Build and maintain a robust pipeline of opportunities using CRM tools and structured follow-up processes. Coordinate with internal teams (technical, operations, PMO) to ensure seamless client onboarding and delivery. Market Intelligence & Strategy Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify trends, gaps, and emerging opportunities in the logistics technology landscape. Provide actionable insights and recommendations to support the department's strategic planning process. Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and networking forums to enhance brand visibility. Solution-Based Business Modelling Develop tailored business models for prospective clients that demonstrate how the company's logistics technology solutions integrate into and enhance their day-to-day operations. Conduct in-depth discovery sessions with potential clients to understand their operational workflows, pain points, and business objectives, then map these to the company's solution capabilities. Design and present use-case scenarios that illustrate the practical, measurable value of the solution within the client's specific operational context (e.g., fleet management, warehouse operations, last-mile delivery, freight tracking). Collaborate with the technical and product teams to translate client operational requirements into viable solution configurations and deployment models. Build financial and operational business cases — including ROI models, cost-benefit analyses, and efficiency projections — that justify adoption of the company's solutions from the client's perspective. Continuously refine business model frameworks based on client feedback, market trends, and evolving product capabilities to ensure relevance and competitiveness. Reporting & Collaboration Prepare and submit regular sales performance reports, pipeline updates, and forecasting to the Head of BD & PMO. Collaborate closely with the PMO Manager to ensure smooth transition of won accounts into project delivery. Contribute to the development of BD strategies, marketing materials, and go-to-market plans Qualification Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum 5–8 years of experience in business development, sales, or commercial strategy, preferably in logistics, SaaS, or digital solutions. Experience in SaaS, TaaS, or digital marketplace solutions. Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets. Demonstrated experience in designing client-specific business models or solution adoption frameworks, ideally within a technology or SaaS environment. Experience working with enterprise or mid-market clients in Saudi Arabia or the broader GCC market.

767f19cb77b8c9d3.description: The Food Hall Operations Manager is the senior operational leader for Seven Al Hamra Food Hall, responsible for the full on-site performance of the Food Hall across operations, tenant management, customer experience, safety, and financial delivery. Reporting to the TGP Food Hall Director, the OM ensures that all Food Hall strategies, brand standards, and commercial objectives are executed at site level. The role acts as the main interface between Head Office functions (Operations, Marketing, Finance, People, Health & Safety) and the on-site teams and tenants. The Operations Manager ensures the Food Hall operates as a world-class hospitality destination, delivering strong financial results, regulatory compliance, and an outstanding guest experience. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Site Leadership & Operations - Lead the full day-to-day operation of the Food Hall across front-of-house, kitchens, back-of-house, delivery, hosting, cashiering, and service areas - Implement, manage, and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all operational areas - Ensure seamless coordination between tenants, service teams, and Head Office departments - Act as the senior decision-maker on site for all operational matters 2. Guest Experience & CRM - Ensure consistent delivery of a world-class guest experience across all touchpoints - Establish and maintain strong customer relationships - Oversee the day-to-day use and performance of the CRM system, ensuring feedback, complaints, and loyalty data are actively managed and acted upon 3. Food Safety, Hygiene & Quality - Ensure full compliance with all food safety, hygiene, and Saudi regulatory standards - Lead and delegate to the Food Safety & Quality Control Coordinator, Chief Steward, and Floor Managers to ensure effective monitoring and enforcement - Ensure consistent food and beverage quality across all operators 4. Maintenance, Facilities & Logistics - Ensure preventive and corrective maintenance is executed according to schedule and standards - Oversee logistics, including staff accommodation standards, transportation, procurement, prep rooms, storage, and waste management systems - Ensure the Food Hall is always safe, clean, and operationally ready 5. Tenant & Commercial Management - Oversee and lead all tenant onboarding, operational management, and end-of-tenancy processes - Monitor operator performance against contractual, quality, and service standards - Build and maintain strong relationships with tenant leadership and brand owners 6. Sales, Marketing & Business Growth - Execute site-level sales and marketing plans developed by Head Office - Support promotions, activations, and events to drive footfall and revenue - Identify and lead local initiatives that improve commercial performance 7. Financial Management - Own the Food Hall’s on-site financial performance, including revenue, cost control, and profitability - Prepare, present, and manage the annual Food Hall budget - Ensure financial discipline across all departments and tenant interfaces 8. People & Performance Management - Lead, coach, and develop the Food Hall management and operational teams - Ensure effective manpower planning, training, and performance management - Drive engagement, accountability, and service culture 9. Performance, KPIs & Reporting - Develop and continuously improve KPIs across all departments - Track and report performance to the TGP Food Hall Director - Lead corrective actions and improvement plans when targets are not met 10. Stakeholder & Industry Relations - Represent Seven Al Hamra Food Hall in the market - Maintain strong relationships with industry partners, operators’ head offices, and key stakeholders Experience & Education - Minimum 10 years in a senior F&B or hospitality management role - Proven experience managing multi-operator environments (food halls, malls or large restaurant groups) - Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or related field Market & Industry Knowledge - Extensive knowledge of the Saudi hospitality and F&B market - Strong network within the local and regional food & beverage industry Technical & Professional Skills - Advanced verbal and written English (Arabic preferred) - Strong financial, operational, and commercial acumen - Advanced user of Microsoft Office, CRM, and ERP systems - Strong understanding of Saudi food safety, labor, and licensing regulations Leadership & Personal Attributes - Excellent people leadership across multicultural teams - Highly organized, decisive, and commercially driven - Strong stakeholder management and negotiation skills - Able to operate effectively in a high-volume, fast-paced environment Note: This job description reflects key duties and responsibilities of the position and is not to be interpreted as exhaustive.

76cd3f2c651c3f73.description: The Design Engineering Manager will lead and manage multidisciplinary engineering design activities for petrochemical and oil & gas projects, with a strong focus on oil and gas separation systems . The role is responsible for overseeing design development across project phases, ensuring compliance with international standards, project specifications, and client requirements, while coordinating with EPC teams and stakeholders. This position is based in China. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage engineering design activities for petrochemical and oil & gas projects. Oversee design of oil & gas separation systems , including process facilities and related units. Manage multidisciplinary engineering teams (process, mechanical, piping, electrical, instrumentation). Review and approve engineering deliverables, calculations, drawings, and technical documents. Ensure engineering designs meet project scope, schedule, quality, and cost objectives. Coordinate with project management, procurement, construction, and commissioning teams. Interface with clients, licensors, vendors, and regulatory authorities. Ensure compliance with international codes, standards, and project specifications. Support technical issue resolution during engineering, procurement, and construction phases. Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and performance management for engineering teams. Educational Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, or related discipline). Master’s degree is an advantage. Experience Requirements Minimum 15 years of engineering experience in petrochemical and oil & gas projects. Proven experience in oil & gas separation systems . Minimum 5 years in a Design Engineering Manager or Lead Engineering role . Strong EPC project experience.
